verdict.rationale: Bitbucket integrates Snyk for automatic security scanning and has an AI code reviewer that 'suggests fixes' for code changes, plus AI-powered pipeline workflows that can automate fixes for some issues, but there is no evidence of AI automatically generating and applying patches specifically for detected security vulnerabilities. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI auto-remediation tied to Snyk/security scan findings, evidence of automatic PR creation/application of security fixes, and independent confirmation this works hands-on.
